_A_NOTIFICATION_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: ANotification shows short messages at the edge of the window, e.g. "Saved". Put <a-notification /> once in the app (e.g. in App.vue) and show messages from anywhere with addNotification() of ANotificationAPI(). Every notification has role="alert", so a screen reader reads it. While the mouse or the focus is on the notifications, they do not disappear.
_A_NOTIFICATION_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: addNotification({ text, type }) shows a notification of the type success, info, warning, danger (success by default, error is the same as danger). It disappears after 5 seconds, timeout: 0 keeps it until it is closed.
_A_NOTIFICATION_TITLE_DESCRIPTION_: title is shown in bold above the text, icon replaces the icon of the type. Texts accept translation keys with extra. announce: "status" lets a screen reader finish the current sentence first, for messages that are not urgent.
_A_NOTIFICATION_ACTIONS_DESCRIPTION_: actions adds buttons, e.g. "Undo". A click calls onClick({ notification, $event }) and closes the notification. The buttons are reachable with Tab, while the focus is on them the notification does not disappear. Give such a notification a longer timeout.
_A_NOTIFICATION_PLACEMENT_DESCRIPTION_: An own area with name: addNotification({ container: name }) shows the notification there. placement sets the edge of the window, size or width (a number is in px) a fixed width instead of the default width in percent. max closes the oldest notifications, here above 3.
_A_NOTIFICATION_PROGRESS_DESCRIPTION_: has-progress shows the remaining time as a bar. Move the mouse onto the notification or focus its close button: the bar and the timer stop.
_A_NOTIFICATION_DEDUPLICATE_DESCRIPTION_: The same notification (same text, type, title, extra and area) is shown only once: it shows the count (×2) and its timer restarts. With deduplicate: false every call adds a notification. Notifications with actions or component are never merged.
_A_NOTIFICATION_REMOVE_DESCRIPTION_: addNotification() returns the id of the notification, removeNotification(id) closes it, e.g. "Saving…" after the answer of the server. clearNotifications() closes all notifications, clearNotifications({ container }) only the notifications of one area.
_A_NOTIFICATION_OWN_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTIO: component shows an own component instead of the text. It gets props, the notification and close(). Title, actions and icon still work.
_A_NOTIFICATION_PROPS_HAS_PROGRESS_DESCR: Shows the remaining time of every notification with a timeout as a bar at its bottom. The bar stops while the notifications are paused. It is hidden from screen readers.
_A_NOTIFICATION_PROPS_MAX_DESCRIPTION_: At most so many notifications in this area, the oldest are closed. Without it there is no limit.
_A_NOTIFICATION_PROPS_NAME_DESCRIPTION_: Name of the area: addNotification({ container: name }) shows the notification in this area. Without a name the area shows the notifications without container.
_A_NOTIFICATION_PROPS_PLACEMENT_DESCRIPT: Edge of the window: top-start, top-center, top-end, bottom-start, bottom-center, bottom-end. start and end follow the direction of the text (RTL).
_A_NOTIFICATION_PROPS_SIZE_DESCRIPTION_: Fixed width: small, large, xl (CSS variables --a_notification_width_*). Without it the width is in percent of the window. Never wider than the window.
_A_NOTIFICATION_PROPS_WIDTH_DESCRIPTION_: Fixed width, a number is in px (360), a string is used as it is ("25rem"). Wins over size.
_A_NOTIFICATION_FUNCTIONS_ADD_DESCRIPTIO: Shows a notification and returns its id. The options are in the next table.
_A_NOTIFICATION_FUNCTIONS_REMOVE_DESCRIP: Closes the notification with this id.
_A_NOTIFICATION_FUNCTIONS_CLEAR_DESCRIPT: Closes all notifications, with container only the notifications of one area, e.g. on logout.
_A_NOTIFICATION_FUNCTIONS_SET_TIMEOUT_DE: Changes the default timeout of all notifications (5000 ms).
_A_NOTIFICATION_FUNCTIONS_PAUSE_DESCRIPT: Stop and continue the timers of an area. ANotification calls them itself while the mouse or the focus is on its notifications.
_A_NOTIFICATION_OPTIONS_TEXT_DESCRIPTION: Text, accepts a translation key and HTML (sanitized). An object becomes a list of its values, e.g. the errors of a form.
_A_NOTIFICATION_OPTIONS_TITLE_DESCRIPTIO: Title in bold above the text. Accepts a translation key.
_A_NOTIFICATION_OPTIONS_TYPE_DESCRIPTION: success, info, warning, danger (error is the same as danger) or another color of AAlert.
_A_NOTIFICATION_OPTIONS_TIMEOUT_DESCRIPT: Time in ms until the notification disappears. 0 keeps it until it is closed. The default is changed with setNotificationTimeout.
_A_NOTIFICATION_OPTIONS_EXTRA_DESCRIPTIO: Values for the placeholders in the translations of text, title and actions.
_A_NOTIFICATION_OPTIONS_ALWAYS_TRANSLATE: Translates the texts even when the translation is switched off.
_A_NOTIFICATION_OPTIONS_ICON_DESCRIPTION: Icon instead of the icon of the type, a name registered with AIconPlugin.
_A_NOTIFICATION_OPTIONS_ANNOUNCE_DESCRIP: How a screen reader announces the notification, as the prop announce of AAlert: alert at once, status after the current sentence.
_A_NOTIFICATION_OPTIONS_ACTIONS_DESCRIPT: Buttons below the text: [{ text, onClick, class, … }], other keys are props of AButton. A click calls onClick({ notification, $event }) and closes the notification.
_A_NOTIFICATION_OPTIONS_COMPONENT_DESCRI: Own component instead of the text. It gets props, notification and close().
_A_NOTIFICATION_OPTIONS_CONTAINER_DESCRI: Name of the area (<a-notification name="…">). Without it the notification goes to <a-notification /> without name.
_A_NOTIFICATION_OPTIONS_DEDUPLICATE_DESC: The same notification is shown only once with the count (×2), and its timer restarts. Notifications with actions or component are never merged.
_A_NOTIFICATION_OPTIONS_USE_VALUES_FROM_: false passes an object in text to the translation as it is instead of making a list of its values.
_A_NOTIFICATION_EXAMPLE_TEXT_DANGER_: The file could not be uploaded.
_A_NOTIFICATION_EXAMPLE_TITLE_BTN_: Show a notification with a title
